name: Bingers
description: Mark the movies and episodes you watch in Jellyfin as watched on bingers.app.
overview: Record your watched media with Bingers

versions.changelog:
<!-- Optional: add a release summary here -->
Install from the plugin repository `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TOomaAh/jellyfin-plugin-bingers/manifest/manifest.json`
or download the zip attached to this release.

- Only mark an item as watched on Bingers when Jellyfin marked it as played for that user and the playback position actually reached Jellyfin's "maximum resume percentage" (90% by default); fixes partially watched items sent as watched when the client does not report its position

<!-- Optional: add a release summary here -->
Install from the plugin repository `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TOomaAh/jellyfin-plugin-bingers/manifest/manifest.json`
or download the zip attached to this release.

- Import and clean up tasks apply their changes batch by batch while matching: a cancelled or failing run keeps what was already done
- Catalog requests are retried on timeouts, network and server errors; a failing show or item is skipped instead of cancelling the whole task
- Copies of a show in several libraries are matched together, so the clean up never removes an episode that another copy has played

<!-- Optional: add a release summary here -->
Install from the plugin repository `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TOomaAh/jellyfin-plugin-bingers/manifest/manifest.json`
or download the zip attached to this release.

- Fix the export failing with "Duplicate pk in batch" when several library items are the same Bingers movie or episode; a batch rejected by Bingers no longer stops the export
- Marking an item unplayed in Jellyfin cancels a pending 'watched' update and marks it unwatched on Bingers (new option, enabled by default)
- Fix the export sending items shown as unplayed in Jellyfin (the played query also matches items whose other version is played)
- New manual task "Clean up watched history on bingers.app": marks as not watched on Bingers the entries whose library items are not played in Jellyfin (opt-in per user, dry run by default)
